summary: Reverse suffix/inner optimizations could confirm an early literal candidate whose match starts after the true leftmost match. For `.bb|b` on `zabb`, the suffix optimization reports 2..3 instead of 1..4. The fix permits these optimizations only when conservative checks establish safe candidate ordering. This reversal removes only the reverse-suffix safety guard. The existing suite_string::default test loads regression/reverse-suffix-start-of-match-failure-011 and checks actual match spans; tests added by the fix check strategy selection. No tests were executed.
